title: 如何理智地训练你的狗?(下)
desc: 如何理智地训练你的狗?(下)

paragraphs.en: To teach a dog to come, you start by standing close to them, saying the cue, and giving them the treat when they come to you. Then you take a step back, and do the same thing.
paragraphs.zh: 要训练狗狗过来，你先站在离它们很近的地方，说出指令，等它们朝你走来时就给它们零食。然后你往后退一步，再做同样的事情。

paragraphs.en: Over time, you call the dog from a greater and greater distance.
paragraphs.zh: 慢慢地，你从越来越远的地方呼唤这只狗。

paragraphs.en: Moberg says she also likes to teach dogs "touch", where their nose presses into the palm of your hand.
paragraphs.zh: 莫伯格说，她还喜欢教狗狗“触碰”技能，也就是让它们用鼻子按压你的手掌。

paragraphs.en: "It allows you to move the dog without having to physically manipulate their body," she says.
paragraphs.zh: 她说：“这能让你无需直接触碰狗狗的身体就能移动它们。”

paragraphs.en: To train this, say the cue, hold an open hand out at snout level, and when your dog touches it with their nose, give them a treat. Repeat.
paragraphs.zh: 想要训练这个动作，你可以说出指令，在狗狗鼻子高度的位置伸出手掌，当狗狗用鼻子触碰手时，给它一份奖励。重复这个过程。

paragraphs.en: Besides basic safety commands, think about training functionally, Sessa says.
paragraphs.zh: 塞萨说，除了基本的安全指令之外，还要考虑进行功能性训练。

paragraphs.en: What is important for you and your dog's life together?
paragraphs.zh: 在你和狗狗的共同生活中，什么是重要的呢？

paragraphs.en: Maybe your dog never needs to be able to lie down, but they need to be able to walk well on a leash. "So focus on that," says Sessa.
paragraphs.zh: 也许你的狗永远不需要会躺下，但它们需要学会戴着牵引绳好好走路。“那就专注于这一点，”塞萨说。

paragraphs.en: "There's no one-size-fits-all training regimen."
paragraphs.zh: “没有一种适用于所有情况的训练方案。”

paragraphs.en: There's no need to spend hours on training.
paragraphs.zh: 没必要花几个小时进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Sessa says she usually suggests her clients work with their dogs for no more than 10 to 15 minutes a day.
paragraphs.zh: 塞萨说，她通常建议客户每天与他们的狗互动的时间不超过10到15分钟。

paragraphs.en: A lot of people think socializing a puppy means introducing them to as many other dogs as possible, says Gagnon. It's actually a much broader task.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说：“很多人认为让幼犬适应社交就是尽可能让它们接触更多其他的狗。实际上，这项任务的内容要丰富得多。”

paragraphs.en: "It's about introducing them to everything that's going to be a part of their world in a positive way," Gagnon says.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说：“这意味着要用积极的方式，向它们介绍即将成为它们世界一部分的所有事物。”

paragraphs.en: If you live in a loud, busy city, for example, it is important to help your puppy get used to loud city sounds. But don't overdo it.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，如果你住在一个嘈杂、繁忙的城市，帮助你的小狗适应城市的嘈杂声音是很重要的。但不要过度训练。

paragraphs.en: "It's not good socialization to take a puppy and put it down right next to a jackhammer," says Gagnon.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说：“把小狗抱过去，直接放在风镐旁边，这可不是良好的社交方式。”

paragraphs.en: If a puppy seems scared or like they're trying to hide, it is important not to push them or make them uncomfortable.
paragraphs.zh: 如果小狗看起来很害怕，或者像是想要藏起来，那就不要强迫它们，也不要让它们感到不舒服，这一点很重要。

paragraphs.en: "You can put them two blocks away from the jackhammer and give them a treat while they're hearing that sound, and that's good socialization."
paragraphs.zh: “你可以把它们放在离风镐两个街区远的地方，在它们听到那个声音的时候给它们点吃的，这是很好的社交训练。”

paragraphs.en: "Food is a great way to help your puppy feel better about things," says Sessa.
paragraphs.zh: 塞萨说：“食物是让你的小狗对事物感受更好的好方法。”

paragraphs.en: For example, if they're meeting new people, have the strangers toss them a treat.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，如果它们要结识新朋友，就让陌生人给它们扔点零食。

paragraphs.en: "That helps them create a positive association," she adds.
paragraphs.zh: 她补充道：“这能帮助它们建立积极的联系。”

paragraphs.en: Experts also suggest enrolling your dog in puppy classes or puppy social hours.
paragraphs.zh: 专家还建议让你的狗狗参加幼犬课程或幼犬社交活动。

paragraphs.en: However, poorly managed puppy groups can do more harm than good.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，管理不善的幼犬群体可能弊大于利。

paragraphs.en: A well-run class, Sessa says, will be small, have the dogs separated by size and collect the dogs' vaccine records.
paragraphs.zh: 塞萨说，一个管理良好的班级规模会很小，会根据狗狗的体型将它们分开，并且会收集狗狗的疫苗接种记录。

paragraphs.en: It should also be moderated by a certified dog trainer.
paragraphs.zh: 它也应该由一位获得认证的训犬师来进行指导。

paragraphs.en: At-home training can be beneficial, but in some situations, it is best to get help from a trainer.
paragraphs.zh: 在家训练可能有好处，但在某些情况下，最好向教练寻求帮助。

paragraphs.en: "If there's anything dangerous, if there have been bites that have resulted in punctures, call a professional," says Gagnon.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说：“如果有任何危险情况，如果被咬后出现了伤口，请联系专业人员。”

paragraphs.en: There's no need to wait until your dog is fully grown.
paragraphs.zh: 不需要等到你的狗完全长大。

paragraphs.en: In particular, if a puppy is having issues with biting, Gagnon suggests reaching out to a trainer, even just for a single session. Remote options are often available.
paragraphs.zh: 特别是，如果小狗有咬人的问题，加尼翁建议联系一位训犬师，哪怕只是上一次课。通常也有远程服务可供选择。

paragraphs.en: "Half an hour online or with phone support can be relatively inexpensive compared to the costs of an aggression problem down the road," she says.
paragraphs.zh: 她说：“与日后处理攻击行为问题的成本相比，半小时的在线或电话咨询费用相对较低。”

paragraphs.en: Professionals can also be helpful when dealing with anxious dogs, because anxiety "can be so case specific", says Gagnon.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说，在应对焦虑的狗狗时，专业人士也能提供帮助，因为焦虑“可能非常具有个案特异性”。

paragraphs.en: For instance, you might think your dog is suffering separation anxiety, but your dog could be stressed about something else.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，你可能认为你的狗患有分离焦虑症，但它其实可能是因为其他事情而感到有压力。

paragraphs.en: A trainer can observe "and tell you what you're dealing with", Gagnon says.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说：“训练师会观察，并且告诉你你所面临的问题。”

paragraphs.en: Finally, it's important to pick a qualified behavior consultant or dog trainer.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，挑选一位合格的行为顾问或训犬师很重要。

paragraphs.en: Sessa recommends looking for professionals who are credentialed with the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers (CCPDT) or the International Association of Animal Behavior Consultants (IAABC).
paragraphs.zh: 塞萨建议寻找那些获得专业训犬师认证委员会（CCPDT）或国际动物行为咨询协会（IAABC）认证的专业人士。

paragraphs.en: New dog owners can easily become overwhelmed by all the information and training options available, Sessa says.
paragraphs.zh: 塞萨说，新的养狗人很容易被现有的所有信息和训练选择弄得不知所措。

paragraphs.en: "Try not to get too caught up with what you're seeing online. Those people haven't interacted with your specific dog."
paragraphs.zh: “尽量不要过度沉迷于你在网上看到的内容。那些人并没有和你所养的那只狗互动过。”
